statement: Perform Inventory Reconciliation enables Distribution Backcasting
source_definition: Reconcile book inventory against measured physical inventory by location and material, quantify and classify gains and losses, investigate variances beyond tolerance, and post agreed corrections so stock records remain accurate and losses are made visible.
target_definition: Reconcile actual distribution inventory availability, movements, deliveries, transportation costs, and customer fulfillment outcomes against the approved distribution plan and its contemporaneous assumptions and constraints; quantify and explain variances; and use validated lessons to improve subsequent distribution planning and optimization cycles.
reviewer_rationale: Reconciled, corrected stock records are the validated inventory truth that distribution backcasting's variance analysis depends on.
Hamid_rationale: Reconciled physical/book inventory is a validated basis for Distribution Backcasting variance analysis. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Manage Production Schedule Exceptions enables Measure Production Scheduling Performance
source_definition: Detect, assess, and resolve deviations from the production schedule — unit upsets, feed or quality surprises, outage changes, and demand shifts — deciding schedule responses, triggering rescheduling, and escalating deviations that break the approved plan to planning.
target_definition: Measure and report how well execution followed the issued production schedule and how stable the schedule itself was — adherence, rescheduling frequency, and exception causes at agreed levels — feeding improvements back into scheduling practice and master data.
reviewer_rationale: Exception management produces the exception records and causes that performance measurement analyzes ('exception causes' is an explicit target input). Source output makes a core part of the target possible.
Hamid_rationale: Schedule exceptions produce exception records/causes that performance measurement explicitly analyzes. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Manage The Interface to Planning, Operations, Engineering & Maintenance enables Create Production Scheduling and Sequencing Plan
source_definition: Run the structured coordination between production scheduling and its counterparties — feasibility and deviation feedback to Refinery Planning and Optimization, executability alignment with refinery operations, and outage, turnaround, and maintenance windows from engineering and maintenance — so the schedule and its neighbors stay mutually consistent.
target_definition: Build the dated production schedule and sequencing plan for the scheduling horizon — assigning campaigns, schedule-level unit commitments, blends, and movements to dates and sequences within the approved plan, the production wheel, and current constraints — producing the schedule that provides the approved basis for refinery execution.
reviewer_rationale: The interface produces outage/turnaround windows, feasibility and executability feedback — the constraints within which the dated schedule must be built. A feasible plan is not possible without them.
Hamid_rationale: Interface supplies feasibility, outage, turnaround, executability inputs needed for a feasible dated schedule. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Manage Confirmation Documentation enables Generate Confirms
source_definition: Maintain the confirmation documentation basis — approved templates and standard wording aligned to governing agreements, the archive of dispatched and matched confirmations, and the evidence trail that shows what was agreed and when — so confirmations are consistent, current, and provable.
target_definition: Produce and dispatch outgoing trade confirmations from captured deal records — using the templates and terms of the governing agreement — and match incoming counterparty confirmations or equivalent contractual acknowledgements against the captured deal record, using the applicable product, agreement, and confirmation standards, chasing unconfirmed trades within applicable timeliness requirements.
reviewer_rationale: Confirmation documentation maintains the approved templates and standard wording the target uses to produce and dispatch confirms. Templates are a direct prerequisite.
Hamid_rationale: Confirmation templates and controlled wording are direct prerequisites for confirmation generation. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Perform Vessel & Barge Actualization enables Identify Potential Demurrage
source_definition: Actualize marine movements by vessel and barge — recording actual loaded and outturn quantities, qualities, and dates from bills of lading, independent inspection reports, and ship and shore figures per marine measurement practice, and identifying apparent voyage gains, losses, and quantity differences according to the contractual measurement basis — so marine transactions settle on verified actuals.
target_definition: Screen completed voyages and terminal operations for potential demurrage, despatch, and detention entitlements and exposures — comparing used against allowed laytime from actualized notices, statements of fact, and timesheets under the governing terms, computing preliminary claim values in both directions, and identifying the contractual deadlines and evidence needed to preserve or defend each claim — so every potential claim is identified before rights lapse.
reviewer_rationale: Actualized voyage data (quantities, dates from BLs/inspections) is explicitly consumed by demurrage screening ('from actualized notices, statements of fact, and timesheets'). Direct enabling input.
Hamid_rationale: Vessel/barge actualization produces actualized movement evidence used to identify demurrage/despatch/detention. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Manage Feedstock Data Quality enables Develop Term Slate
source_definition: Steward the crude and feedstock quality data used in evaluation, planning, and trading — maintaining current, validated assays and quality records, tracking assay age and representativeness, incorporating new laboratory and cargo data under controlled update procedures, and distributing consistent quality data to the consuming models and processes.
target_definition: Develop the recommended term feedstock procurement slate — the portfolio of crudes and feedstocks proposed for supply under agreements with multi-period or continuing commercial commitments, screened for refinery quality compatibility and evaluated for sustained economic attractiveness — so term procurement and the feedstock recommendation rest on a quality-assured base-load supply plan.
reviewer_rationale: Stewarded quality data (validated assays, representativeness) is distributed to consuming models; the term slate is explicitly 'screened for refinery quality compatibility' on that base.
Hamid_rationale: Validated feedstock-quality data underpins term-slate quality screening and refinery compatibility. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Set up Intellectual Asset Framework enables Protect Intellectual Assets
source_definition: Establish and maintain the intellectual-asset framework — asset categories, identification and disclosure procedures, ownership and decision-rights principles, and handling rules — operationalizing approved Legal IP policy, so intellectual assets are recognized and handled consistently from creation.
target_definition: Protect intellectual assets operationally — confidentiality and trade-secret practice, misuse monitoring, and coordination of enforcement through Legal — continuously, across everything the framework classifies as worth protecting.
reviewer_rationale: The framework establishes what counts as an intellectual asset (categories, identification, handling rules); protection operates 'across everything the framework classifies as worth protecting'. Framework makes protection possible.
Hamid_rationale: IP framework defines the classification/handling basis under which protection operates. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Collaborate with Research Partners enables Conduct Research
source_definition: Collaborate with external research partners — universities, institutes, suppliers, and technology providers — on research and development of mutual interest, under agreements Legal executes and the IP framework governs.
target_definition: Conduct the research that tests candidate concepts — customer and consumer concept research, technical investigation, and market and commercial assessment — producing feasibility evidence with stated confidence for the concept recommendation.
reviewer_rationale: External research collaboration may support research, but conducting research (testing candidate concepts) does not require it. No established dependency in the definitions; at most 'supports'.
Hamid_rationale: External collaboration may support but is not required for internal research. Correct to informs or a future supports relation. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Perform Account Planning enables Sales Execution
source_definition: Perform account planning for the accounts and account groups the sales plan prioritizes — objectives, opportunity maps, action plans, and resource assumptions per account — feeding execution and the forecast-input process with account-level evidence.
target_definition: Execute the sales effort against the plans — pipeline, opportunities, key accounts, quotes, contracts and orders, and non-retail customer serving — as the commercial pursuit whose qualified outcomes are handed to the controlled transaction processes, measured against its own plan.
reviewer_rationale: Account planning explicitly 'feeds execution with account-level evidence'; sales execution runs 'against the plans'. The plan is the basis that makes directed execution possible.
Hamid_rationale: Account planning explicitly feeds Sales Execution with account-level objectives, opportunity maps, actions, evidence. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Develop and Monitor Commercial Revenue Plan enables Analyze Customer Profitability
source_definition: Develop the commercial revenue plan — the monetized operating outlook of the agreed sales plan by customer, channel, product, and period — and monitor actual revenue against it, analyzing deviations and routing findings to the accountable owners according to cause.
target_definition: Analyze the profitability of customers, accounts, channels, and segments: apply Finance-approved costing and allocation methods to revenue, cost-to-serve, terms, rebate, and credit data to produce profitability views and insights that inform pricing strategy, terms decisions, credit reviews, and account management.
reviewer_rationale: The revenue plan provides the monetized outlook by customer/channel/product/period that profitability analysis builds on. A supporting analytical input, directionally sensible; not mere adjacency.
Hamid_rationale: Revenue plan not demonstrated as necessary for profitability analysis (consumes actual revenue, cost-to-serve, terms, rebates, credit data). Likely informs; dependsOnOutputOf only if business confirms plan-based analysis. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Define Financing & Payment Methods enables Manage Customer Invoicing and Billing
source_definition: Define the approved financing options, payment methods, payment-term menus, eligibility conditions, and customer-facing commercial rules that may be offered within Treasury-approved instruments, Credit-approved exposure rules, Tax/Legal requirements, and delegated authorities.
target_definition: The process of billing customers for delivered products and services: creating and distributing invoices from confirmed evidence and governed commercial data, determining transaction taxes per the Tax function's determinations, accounting for customer self-billing under executed agreements, and issuing every correction — credit memos, exception invoices, reversals, and rebills — as controlled document events.
reviewer_rationale: Defined financing options, payment methods, term menus and commercial rules are the governed inputs invoicing must bill against. Necessary prerequisite.
Hamid_rationale: Approved financing/payment methods, terms, eligibility, commercial rules are governed prerequisites for billing. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Perform Self-Billing Accounting enables Perform Revenue Accounting
source_definition: Account for customer self-billing arrangements: receive customer-issued billing documents under executed self-billing agreements, validate each against confirmed fulfillment evidence and governed prices and terms, record the validated self-bill, and resolve differences with the customer per the agreement.
target_definition: Execute revenue accounting under Finance-approved policy: recognize revenue as performance obligations are satisfied per the approved recognition model, account for deferred and unbilled revenue, coordinate revenue-affecting accruals with the accrual processes, enforce revenue cutoff, and deliver revenue accounting into period-end close.
reviewer_rationale: Validated self-billing records must flow into revenue accounting for recognition and cutoff. Necessary feed.
Hamid_rationale: Validated self-billing records are necessary inputs to revenue recognition, cutoff, accounting. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Manage Invoice Exceptions, Reversals, and Rebilling enables Manage Cash Application, A/R & Revenue Accounting
source_definition: Correct billing through controlled document events: validate the correction's basis and authorization, and create the proper controlled document type under approved rules — full cancellation, partial correction, replacement/rebill, debit adjustment, tax-only correction, or exception invoice — with coded reasons and the applicable approvals, preserving the complete original-to-correction chain.
target_definition: The process of turning billed transactions into accounted revenue and settled receivables: Record and process receipt notifications, bank/lockbox/acquirer settlement information, remittance evidence, and accounting events relating to customer payments received through Treasury-managed arrangements. Capture remittance information, apply receipts against governed receivables, manage unapplied and exception items to resolution, reconcile receivables against bank and processor settlement information and the general ledger, and perform revenue accounting under Finance-approved policy.
reviewer_rationale: Corrected billing documents (cancellations, rebills, adjustments) are necessary for correct cash application and revenue accounting.
Hamid_rationale: Corrected billing documents are necessary to accurate receivables, cash application, revenue accounting. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Measure Service Infrastructure enables Manage Technology
source_definition: Measure the performance of the service infrastructure from the business perspective: facilities fitness, technology and platform performance, and contact-channel performance — as evidence for the accountable owners.
target_definition: Own the service operation's technology from the business side: define requirements and business configuration for service platforms (case, telephony, knowledge, workforce tools), drive adoption and fit-for-purpose use, and feed the service capability roadmap — with IT owning the platforms themselves.
reviewer_rationale: Measuring infrastructure performance provides evidence 'for the accountable owners' that informs technology management and the roadmap — but management does not require it to function. Better verb: informs.
Hamid_rationale: Infrastructure performance evidence informs the technology roadmap; it does not enable technology management. Correct to informs. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Supply Network Participation Analysis enables Refined Product Demand Management
source_definition: Analyze the refined-product supply network's market participation — segmenting customers and markets on supply economics, evaluating market attractiveness for supply-network participation, and assessing cost-to-serve performance — and recommend where and whom the network should serve profitably, informing the network and participation decisions of the accountable commercial and planning owners.
target_definition: Manage refined-product demand on the supply side — maintaining the operational demand picture the supply chain runs on, forecasting location-level product demand for supply operations, and managing product-exchange volumes as a balancing lever — so supply operations, replenishment, and trading coordination work from one current, operational demand view.
reviewer_rationale: Participation analysis recommends where/whom the network should serve — strategic scoping for commercial decisions. Demand management (operational demand picture, location-level forecasting) can run without it. Better verb: informs, not enables.
Hamid_rationale: Participation analysis informs commercial/supply scoping; operational demand management runs without it. Correct to informs. Hamid 2026-09-25.

statement: Brand Strategy enables Sales & Distribution Channel Strategy
source_definition: Develop and maintain the approved brand strategy for the company's downstream fuels and products marketing — brand positioning, brand architecture, and where and how the brand competes — through a recurring, hypothesis-driven strategy cycle grounded in the governed marketing evidence base and the applicable enterprise delegation and approval process, so brand investments and branded-channel commitments follow deliberate, evidenced, approved direction.
target_definition: Develop and maintain the approved strategic channel-of-trade direction for downstream sales and distribution — which routes to market the company participates in, their strategic roles, and the target channel mix — through a recurring cycle of channel diagnostics and hypothesis-driven strategy development under the applicable enterprise approvals, so channel design and channel management execute a deliberate, evidenced, approved direction.
reviewer_rationale: Brand strategy provides positioning/architecture context for channel choice, but channel strategy (routes to market, channel mix) does not require it to function. Influence, not enablement. Better verb: informs.
Hamid_rationale: Brand positioning may influence channel direction but is not a prerequisite for channel strategy. Correct to informs. Hamid 2026-09-25.
